name: The Black Shield
label: Quest
description: At Brackenwall Village, Do'gol has noticed lettering along the shield's edge, but burned residue hides it. Clearing it needs acid, and Do'gol asks you…
intro: At Brackenwall Village, Do'gol has noticed lettering along the shield's edge, but burned residue hides it. Clearing it needs acid, and Do'gol asks you for six venom sacs from the Darkfang spiders of the marsh.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.
I need acid to make it clear. Venom from the Darkfang spiders in the marsh would do good. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get them sacs from the spiders?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't like spiders that are so big I can't sit on them and squish them.
Thanks for getting them, friend. Now I rip them open and pour them onto the shield...
